name: cavemio-voice-note
title: Voice note
description: A voice message you can scrub and read along with: the waveform fills, the time rolls, and the transcript highlights each word as it’s said.

cavemio.usage:
import { VoiceNote } from "@/components/voice-note";

<VoiceNote
  src="/notes/sam.mp3"
  label="Voice note from Sam"
  unread
  transcript={[{ text: "Hey,", start: 0.1 }, { text: "quick", start: 0.8 }, /* … */]}
/>
cavemio.accessibility:
- The waveform is a slider: arrow keys move two seconds, Home and End go to the ends, and it reads its position as "0:04 of 0:11".
- The play button says Play or Pause, the speed pill says its speed, and the transcript is plain text in the page.
- Starting one voice note pauses any other on the page.
- Peaks given up front avoid downloading the whole file just to draw it; without them the audio is decoded once with Web Audio (the file has to be same-origin or allow CORS).
- Installs Number roll. With reduced motion the bars, icon, highlight and fold change in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: peaks
props.description: – · Loudness from 0 to 1, any length; resampled to the bars that fit. Without them the file is fetched and decoded to work them out.

props.name: duration
props.description: – · Seconds, shown until the audio’s own length is known.

props.name: transcript
props.description: – · The words in order with when each is said. Adds the Transcript fold.

props.name: defaultTranscriptOpen
props.description: false · Start with the transcript open.

props.name: speeds
props.description: [1, 1.5, 2] · What the speed pill steps through.

props.name: unread
props.description: false · Show the dot until it’s played.

props.name: label
props.description: "Voice note" · Names the group for assistive tech, e.g. "Voice note from Sam".

props.name: onPlay / onEnded
props.description: – · When it starts playing, and when it reaches the end.

features.title: A waveform you can scrub
features.description: Press and drag and the bars under your finger swell. Letting go carries on from there.

features.title: Play, pause and speed
features.description: The icon morphs between play and pause, and the speed steps through 1×, 1.5× and 2× without changing the pitch.

features.title: A transcript that follows
features.description: A highlight glides from word to word as they are said. Tap a word to play from there.

features.title: Quick to show
features.description: Pass the waveform peaks up front and the file does not have to be downloaded just to draw it.

features.title: One at a time
features.description: Starting one voice note pauses any other on the page.

features.title: Unread and keyboard
features.description: A dot marks unplayed notes. The waveform is a slider where arrow keys move two seconds.

states.title: arrive
states.description: The bars grow from 3px to their loudness (520ms), 7ms apart from left to right.

states.title: play / pause
states.description: One icon of two quads: the halves of the triangle slide and square off into the two pause bars (clip-path, 320ms). Bars fill left to right; the time counts up in rolling digits.

states.title: scrub
states.description: Pressing pauses it; the bars near the pointer scale up to 1.5× with a soft falloff (160ms) and the time shows where you are; releasing seeks there and plays on if it was playing.

states.title: speed
states.description: 1× → 1.5× → 2× roll in place; the pitch stays the same.

states.title: transcript
states.description: Folds open under the note (grid rows, 420ms). The current word’s highlight glides to the next word (260ms); words already said are in ink, the rest in grey. Tapping a word plays from its start.

states.title: end
states.description: Holds full for 500ms, then the fill runs back to the start (600ms) and the time rolls back to the length.

states.title: unread
states.description: A small dot by the time; it shrinks away the first time it plays.
